task.title: Reviewing the claim for existing violation

step.cmd: In FTS, review the violation history (ML02):

ul.li: If one or more violations are present, go to step 2.
If there is no violation, go to Manual input of tax exemption for First Nations individual . Manual input of tax exemption for First Nations individual

step.cmd: Determine if one of the following conditions is met:

ul.li: The notice of violation was issued more than 260 weeks before the date of the initial application, or;

2 initial claims have been established since the date the notice was issued.
If no, go to step 3
If yes, go to Manual input of tax exemption for First Nations individual . Manual input of tax exemption for First Nations individual

step.cmd: To determine the classification of the violation, refer to Self-employed: Information on calculation and entitlement to special benefits — Knowledge
